title: Property of the week: A CT contemporary is a private retreat above a valley with ‘unforgettable’ view
snippet: Burlington contemporary is a private retreat above the Farmington Valley. PUBLISHED: July 12, 2026 … 4,637-square-foot residence has been extensively renovated
extractedText: Breaking News Unhealthy air quality and severe thunderstorms expected across Connecticut July 18, 2026 at 12:03 pm BusinessReal Estate Property of the week: A CT contemporary is a private retreat above a valley with ‘unforgettable’ view Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share on Bluesky (Opens in new window) Bluesky Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Threads (Opens in new window) Threads Share on Reddit (Opens in new window) Reddit 86 Taine Mountain Road, Burlington By James AlexanderPUBLISHED: July 12, 2026 at 5:30 AM EDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...“There are homes that impress and there are homes that inspire,” said Donna Meté, the owner of this impressive contemporary. It is a home perched high atop Taine Mountain in Burlington. “This home belongs in the latter category,” she added. From this property, located at 86 Taine Mountain Road, you can enjoy sweeping panoramic views that stretch across Farmington Valley, and enjoy a landscape that is transformed by the changing seasons. “Vibrant summer greens give way to brilliant autumn foliage before winter blankets the valley in sparkling white. It is a view that captivates every day, offering a rare sense of serenity and perspective,” Meté said. “The view,” added Catherine McCahill without hesitation, “is unforgettable.” McCahill, with William Pitt Sotheby’s International Realty, is handling the sale. Yet the scenery is only the beginning. Positioned to embrace its surroundings, this 4,637-square-foot residence has been extensively renovated to blend modern luxury with timeless comfort. “Large windows invite natural light into expansive living spaces while framing the breathtaking scenery as living artwork from nearly every room,” Meté said. 86 Taine Mountain Road, Burlington The formal living room on the main level is elegant and inviting. It features soaring ceilings and large windows for dramatic views. It also has a contemporary wood stove, while a separate gas fireplace creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere throughout the seasons. Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the chef’s kitchen is also impressive. Anchored by a generous center island, it features granite countertops, premium appliances, abundant cabinetry, and an open dining area where every meal is accompanied by spectacular views. “Sliding glass doors lead to an elevated deck that is perfect for enjoying a morning cup of coffee, outdoor dining, or evening sunsets,” said Meté. Adjacent to the kitchen, the family room offers an intimate retreat. Rich knotty pine walls, wide-plank pine flooring, a vaulted ceiling, and a magnificent stone fireplace create the ambiance of a luxury mountain lodge. A second deck that is accessible from the family room invites residents to step outside and experience the peaceful beauty of the surrounding landscape. Also on the main level, the primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with expansive valley views, a spacious walk-in closet and a beautifully renovated spa-inspired bath featuring a soaking tub, separate shower, and dual vanities. With its main level location, this home is an obvious candidate for people interested in one-floor living and aging in place. A half bath, with room for a washer and dryer and access to the attached two-car garage complete the main level and are just a short distance from the kitchen. The upper level offers two additional bedrooms connected by a Jack-and-Jill bath, along with a versatile loft overlooking the valley. Whether used as a home office, fitness studio, reading lounge, or guest retreat, this loft offers flexibility while continuing to showcase the home’s remarkable setting. The loft also has a deck, which provides one more opportunity to take in the scenery from outside. 86 Taine Mountain Road, Burlington Adding to this home’s flexibility is the fully finished walk-out lower level with its separate private entrance. Complete with a bedroom, full bath, second kitchen, family room, recreation area, fireplace, laundry room, and stunning valley views, it offers an ideal opportunity for intergenerational living or an au pair. Here there is a bedroom next to a full bath, a walk-in closet and the home’s second laundry room. An adjacent room can serve as a recreation area or living room. Just beyond is a second fully equipped kitchen that is open to a family room, which has the home’s third fireplace. The bedroom, rec room, and family room enjoy full valley views, as does the kitchen when people there look through the large family room window. In addition to offering exceptional accommodations for extended family members, guests, multigenerational living, or an au pair, it also can serve as a children’s play area or a retreat for teens. Beyond its beauty, the home reflects meticulous ownership.
